# Commands console reliability, Commit UI, task recovery, storage retention, and patch identity

Review setup fetches paired Firefox/comm `origin/main` revisions, verifies patch ancestry, and pauses before build/AI on application conflicts. Use `mach tb-rust vendor` once and retry the build once; retain error/paused paired task trees under `~/.tb-tools/worktrees/task-<id>`. Rust status must read local fetched refs and cache by both revision hashes, not poll GitHub. [Task 7]

Scope: console.
